details.jobDescription:
ENGIE Romania is an integrated energy provider offering sustainable solutions through the supply of natural gas, renewable electricity, technical services, and energy efficiency, actively contributing to the energy transition.︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉



At ENGIE, we accelerate the energy transition through innovation and technology. Artificial intelligence is a key pillar of this transformation. We are looking for an AI Engineer who will actively contribute to the development of tomorrow’s AI solutions.



In this role, you will work closely with business needs and translate them into effective AI solutions. You will design, implement, and optimize Generative AI solutions that deliver tangible value and create real impact across the organization.
Responsabilities:
  • Analysis of business requirements and their transformation into concrete AI solutions.
  • Collaboration with business teams to identify and prioritize AI use cases.
  • Design and implementation of Generative AI solutions, including chatbots, assistants, and AI agents.
  • Definition and implementation of RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation) architectures using vector databases.
  • Integration of LLM models approved within the ENGIE ecosystem (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI).
  • Ensuring the integration of AI solutions with ENGIE’s enterprise architecture systems (SAP, Salesforce, Datalake, MyENGIE, Call Center, Microsoft 365).
  • Ensuring compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (AI Act, GDPR, internal policies).
  • Configuration of security mechanisms, access control, and data protection for AI solutions.
  • Monitoring the performance, costs, and accuracy of implemented Generative AI solutions.
  • Implementation of logging, monitoring, alerting, and cost control mechanisms for AI solutions.
  • Testing the functionality, accuracy, and robustness of generated responses, including hallucination reduction.
  • Development and optimization of prompts, conversation templates, and AI workflows.
  • Providing technical support and evolutionary maintenance for AI solutions running in production.
  • Implementation of RAG architectures over internal and external data sources.
  • Documentation of developed AI solutions in line with the ENGIE project methodology.
  • Technical documentation of delivered AI solutions and underlying architectures.
  • Contribution to the definition of internal standards for the use of artificial intelligence within the organization.
  • Ensuring knowledge transfer to IT and business teams.
  • Continuous evaluation of technologies and trends in the Generative AI domain.

Desired education, expertise, and skills:
  • University degree in IT or related fields, completed with a Bachelor’s degree (e.g. Automation, Cybernetics, Computer Science, etc.);
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in IT / software development / data / AI;
  • At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience working with AI / Generative AI solutions in real-world (non‑POC) environments;
  • Experience delivering end‑to‑end solutions, from business requirements through to production;
  • Experience working in an enterprise environment (processes, security, governance);
  • Advanced proficiency in Python programming;
  • Hands-on experience with AI and LLM orchestration frameworks, such as LangChain or LlamaIndex;
  • Intermediate-level knowledge in the following areas:
    • LangGraph and/or LangChain for AI agents;
    • LLM APIs (Azure, AWS, Google);
    • Vector databases, embeddings, and RAG architectures;
    • API and microservices development.

Benefits:
  • Private health insurance for you and your family;
  • Opportunities for ongoing personal and professional development;
  • Meal tickets;
  • Annual extended holiday entitlement, depending on length of employment;
  • Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment;
  • Safe workplace equipped with state-of-the-art tools and technologies;
  • Direct contribution to the energy transition and sustainability;
  • Work-life balance.

Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.


If you decide to send us your personal information in order to apply for this position, please be aware of our job candidate GDPR Data Privacy Notice: https://www.engie.ro/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ER_Nota-de-informare-Candidati.pdf



Why We Care:
At ENGIE, we believe that every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. We make a difference and provide a fulfilling professional experience. Accept interesting challenges and build a career that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of this century's adventure!

ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, or any other protected status under the law.

Despre ENGIE Romania

Grupul ENGIE este o referință globală în domeniul energiei și al serviciilor cu emisii reduse de carbon. Alături de cei 4.250 de angajați din România, de clienți, parteneri și părți interesate, ne angajăm să accelerăm tranziția către o economie cu impact neutru în ceea ce privește emisiile de carbon, printr-un consum redus de energie și soluții prietenoase cu mediul. Inspirați de ambiția noastră, îmbinăm performanța economică cu producerea unui impact pozitiv asupra oamenilor și planetei, bazându-ne pe activitățile noastre cheie – gaze naturale, energie electrică, servicii tehnice – pentru a oferi soluții competitive clienților noștri.
